name: TMI-2
english_description: A historically significant, widely-copied English-language LPMud mudlib from 1992-1996 whose std/ base classes, command-soul dispatch, and /adm/-rooted security-daemon layout were inherited by a large family of later mudlibs (this project's own catalog refers to a 'TMI-2/Falcon family' of descendants). This port is the 'famous TMI-2 quad' release itself: a landing zone with a general-purpose bulletin board, an Intermud-3 network-discussion room, a MudOS-driver-discussion room, a bug-report room, and a link down into /d/Fooland, plus the full TMI-2 wizard toolset (file/object inspection commands, the channel system, a student/teacher tutorial subsystem, FTP and HTTP daemons, and a resolv_str/resolv_ref scripting mini-language for wizard reference variables) and character creation across 13 playable races (dwarf, elf, gnome, human, orc, troll, halfling, sprite, shadow, ent, siren, skeleton, zombie). This collection's other TMI-2 1.4alpha-descended archive, mortremains, shares this lib's own credit line ("Truilkan@TMI") and hit a related destructed-object bug from the same underlying pattern, though the two trigger it via slightly different call paths. Booting this lib also opens a real outbound connection to the public Intermud-3 router network, matching genuine upstream behavior rather than a bug. Porting surfaced several driver-dialect-mismatch bugs typical of a MudOS-era codebase, the most severe an empty-array crash in master.lpc's domain_file() that aborted the driver's own boot sequence before a single connection could be accepted; all are fixed.
